name: US equity stress
summary: VIX 19.5 and S&P 500 3.8% below its high on 10 Nov, both just inside Normal lines; measured floor keeps Watch
state: The VIX closed near 19.5 on 10 Nov, just under the 20 line, down from above 25 on 6 Nov (Yahoo Finance). The S&P 500 ended near 7,521, 3.8% below its 52-week high of 7,819 and 2.2% lower on the week, after a worst day of -4.4% in the past five sessions. Both readings now sit inside the Normal lines, but the measured floor keeps Watch until they clear them more decisively.
for_you: Share prices have been swinging more than usual. People with investments or pensions in US shares may see larger day-to-day moves than normal.
rubric_hit: VIX 18.5 has not yet cleared the 18 exit line, so Watch holds
why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
